besluite.fout: 'klaar' for 'already' is colloquial in written study text.
besluite.rede: 'al' is the standard written form with the same meaning and no loss of plainness for a Grade 4 reader.

besluite.fout: 'uitgehol tot 'n potvorm' is stiff, and the compound 'potvorm' is unusual.
besluite.rede: 'in die vorm van 'n pot uitgehol' is the natural construction, says the same thing and is plainer for a Grade 4 reader.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses ('Jy slaan' / 'die vel gee').
besluite.rede: Both sides have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

besluite.fout: 'dit' directly follows 'die vel' and 'die klank', so its referent is unclear.
besluite.rede: Naming the ngoma fixes the pronoun without changing the fact, and the protected 'gewoonlik' stays intact.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses ('Die riwwe gee' / 'vorm hulle').
besluite.rede: Both sides have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

besluite.fout: The trailing 'en ook in Afrika' after the separable verb is clumsy and reads as if Africa were one of the countries.
besluite.rede: ', ook in Afrika' is the idiomatic form and keeps exactly the same claim.

besluite.fout: 'Hoor eers watter instrument ...' is a stiff imperative for directing attention.
besluite.rede: 'Let eers op' is the natural instruction, and the listening context of the preceding 'Luister' sentence keeps the sense of listening.

besluite.fout: 'Hoor dan watter klank ...' is the same stiff imperative.
besluite.rede: Same fix as change 7, keeping the two parallel instructions consistent.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses ('kom een instrument ... in' / 'hoor jy').
besluite.rede: Both sides have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

'wat jou deel aan die klankprent gedoen het' deliberately echoes the earlier heading 'Wat elke instrument aan die stuk doen' (the part's function), and 'tot ... bygedra' changes the preposition and verb, shifting it to 'contribution' and breaking the link that 'dieselfde woorde' in the next sentence relies on.
